newsitem.title: BRUNEI: Singapore, Brunei to hold talks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, Brunei to hold talks.

text.p: A delegation of ministers from Singapore will visit this oil-rich country beginning on Monday for bilateral meetings, officials from both countries said at the weekend.

The visit is part of a regular series of exchanges between Singapore and Brunei which began in 1990, a statement from Singapore's Ministry of Foreign Affairs said. Singapore hosted the last exchange in 1995.
Singapore's delegation will include Minister for Foreign Affairs S. Jayakumar, Minister for Home Affairs Wong Kan Seng and Yeo Cheow Tong, minister for health and minister for the environment.
Private sector representatives will meet their Brunei counterparts, the Singapore statement said.
There was no indication from the officials if there would be any discussions on currency.

Singapore and Brunei said last month that they had no intention of ending their currency interchangeability agreement, contrary to market speculation. The Brunei dollar is pegged to the Singapore dollar.
